explanationMd: First exclude x = −1. The equation gives 3/(x + 1) = −1, so x + 1 = −3 and x = −4. Substituting gives −1 + 1 = 0.

distractorRationale.b: This changes the sign when isolating the fraction.
distractorRationale.a: The left side becomes −3 + 1, not zero.
distractorRationale.e: The fraction is positive, so adding one cannot give zero.
